# PR Review: review-01-messy-ts-app

Categorising all 37 findings by merge action, using severity + `agent_risk` as the primary signals.

## Block merge (4)

These are high-severity findings where the evidence shows latent correctness or determinism bugs an agent extending this code is likely to trip over.

| ID | Charge | File | Sev / agent_risk | Why block |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| crime_00002 | Temporal Recklessness | `src/date.ts` | high / 0.62 | 8× `Date.now()`/`new Date()` in domain code. Non-deterministic behaviour + untestable without monkey-patching. Cheap fix (inject a clock) — no reason to ship as-is. |
| crime_00003 | Half-UTC, Half-Local | `src/date.ts` | high / 0.61 | Same receiver `d` mixes `getUTCFullYear()` and `getMonth()`. Silent UTC-offset bugs are the classic "works on my laptop" defect. High confidence (0.85), small effort. |
| crime_00005 | God Function | `src/billing.ts` `generateInvoice` | high / 0.55 | 204-line function, 3.4× the threshold. Severity 0.9, confidence 0.95. Refunds/invoices are exactly the surface where an agent edit will silently break a sibling branch. |
| crime_00001 | SVG With Embedded Raster | `src/assets/partner-logo.svg` | high / 0.70 | High severity + high confidence, and the fix is small. Borderline (asset, not logic) — but high-sev with a `small`-effort fix shouldn't ship just because nobody loves auditing SVGs. |

## Warn (15)

Medium-severity findings, plus a few lows whose `agent_risk` is high enough that an agent editing this surface will likely propagate the problem. Land the PR if there's schedule pressure, but file follow-ups.

| ID | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| crime_00004 | Concept Alias Drift (tenant/account/org/team/workspace) | medium / 0.58 | 4 aliases across 5 files — agents will duplicate logic under the wrong name. Worth resolving before more code piles on. |
| crime_00006 | Missing Agent Context | medium / 0.53 | No `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`/SKILL files. Self-inflicted: every future agent edit is harder. |
| crime_00007 | Dev-Server URL `localhost:3000` | medium / 0.53 | Will silently fail in any non-dev environment. |
| crime_00008 | Localhost-on-Disk `/Users/andrew/…` | medium / 0.53 | Hardcoded user-home path — broken on every other machine. |
| crime_00009 | Timezone Roulette | medium / 0.53 | 2 timezone-less `new Date(...)` literals. Latent off-by-a-day. |
| crime_00010 | String Sprinkles `"enterprise"` × 4 files | medium / 0.52 | Policy literal scattered across api/billing/jobs/ui. Next plan-tier rename is going to hurt. |
| crime_00011 | DST-Naive Day Math (`+ 86400000`) | medium / 0.52 | Two days a year it's wrong. Worth a calendar lib swap. |
| crime_00015 | Duplicated Navigation Source | medium / 0.49 | `/settings/billing` labelled "Plans" in registry, "Billing" in sidebar. Pairs with #17. |
| crime_00016 | Unfinished Business (14 TODOs, `src/todo.ts`) | medium / 0.49 | 424 markers/kLOC — agents can't tell which behaviour is load-bearing. |
| crime_00017 | Route Metadata Drift `/settings/billing` | medium / 0.49 | 4 competing labels (path, component `PricingPage`, title `Plans`, `<title>Subscription`, two nav entries). High agent-confusion surface. |
| crime_00019 | Temporal Recklessness (`src/billing.ts`, 7 sites) | medium / 0.46 | Same shape as #00002 but in billing — same fix lands both. |
| crime_00020 | Test That Proves Nothing — `"renders the enterprise plan"` | medium / 0.46 | 0 assertions. False confidence in the billing test file specifically. Fix or delete before merging. |
| crime_00021 | False Identity — `calculateRefundPreview` does I/O | medium / 0.44 | `saveRefundAudit`/`sendRefundEmail` inside a `calculate*` name. Refund-side-effect mislabeling is exactly the kind of bug an agent edit cascades. |
| crime_00026 | God File `src/billing.ts` (310 LOC) | medium / 0.42 | Pairs with #5. Splitting will help both. |
| crime_00027 | Logic in the Alibi | medium / 0.42 | "Only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves." Sitting in a comment, not enforced in code. Same file as the refund function above — meaningful. |

## Ignore (18)

Low-severity findings where the cost of landing them is low. Note these aren't suppressions — they're "fine to merge, fix opportunistically".

| ID | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| crime_00012 | Oversized Raster (254 KB) | low / 0.52 | Below the medium-sized threshold (500 KB). Web-vitals nit. |
| crime_00013 | Docs-Code Drift (`docs/teams.md` → `./setup.md`) | low / 0.51 | One dead link. Trivial. |
| crime_00014 | Icon-Sized Raster (32×32 PNG) | low / 0.50 | Cosmetic. |
| crime_00022 | Sync I/O in Hot Path (`loadPlanSchema`) | low / 0.44 | Borderline — if `loadPlanSchema` is a one-shot at boot it's fine; if it runs per-request, promote to warn. Confirm call frequency before ignoring. |
| crime_00023 | Temporal Recklessness (`src/api/state.ts`, 1 site) | low / 0.44 | Subsumed by the clock-injection fix from #2/#19. |
| crime_00024 | Date String Sewing | low / 0.43 | Same date.ts cleanup. |
| crime_00025 | Host-Locale Drift | low / 0.43 | Same. |
| crime_00028 | Unprefixed Boolean (`paid`/`expired`/`stale`) | low / 0.42 | Style. |
| crime_00029 | Unprefixed Boolean (`disableBilling`/`skipRetry`) | low / 0.42 | Style. |
| crime_00030 | Option Bag Junk Drawer | low / 0.40 | Type-tightening opportunity. |
| crime_00031 | Return Shape Roulette | low / 0.40 | Type-tightening opportunity. |
| crime_00032 | Negative Flag Maze | low / 0.40 | Cosmetic; will be touched when #29 is fixed. |
| crime_00033 | Plural Mismatch (`users: User`, `invoice: Invoice[]`) | low / 0.40 | Style. |
| crime_00034 | Orphaned `/account/subscription` | low / 0.39 | Confidence 0.65 — might be in-flight work. Verify, don't auto-delete. |
| crime_00035 | Orphaned `/team` | low / 0.39 | Same. |
| crime_00036 | Orphaned `/workspace/members` | low / 0.39 | Same. |
| crime_00037 | Weak test "creates an invoice" | low / 0.34 | Lower priority than the no-assertion test in #20, same file. |
| crime_00038 | Unfinished Business in `billing.ts` (12.9 / kLOC) | low / 0.32 | Barely over threshold. |

## Suggested PR review comment

> Blocking on the **billing/date determinism cluster**: `generateInvoice` is a 204-line god function (crime_00005), `src/date.ts` mixes UTC/local methods on the same receiver and reads the system clock 8× (crimes 2/3), and the partner-logo SVG embeds rasters (crime_00001). Plus 15 medium-severity warnings, dominated by `/settings/billing` having 4 different labels and `calculateRefundPreview` quietly performing side effects — both are high-cascade surfaces for any agent (or human) extending this code.
